optional_parameters.description: Unique reference, if this parameter is absent, no status report is sent.
optional_parameters.name: reference

optional_parameters.description: The date on which the message needs to be sent.
optional_parameters.name: timestamp

optional_parameters.description: Replace non GSM-7 characters by appropriate valid GSM-7 characters.
optional_parameters.name: replacechars

optional_parameters.description: When sending a message, you can specify what type of message it is. You can send messages in 3 types (normal / binary / flash).
optional_parameters.name: type

optional_parameters.description: The UDH parameter is required if you want to send a binary SMS. This parameter needs to contain the "header" of the SMS message.
optional_parameters.name: udh

optional_parameters.description: If test is TRUE, then the message is not actually sent or scheduled, and there will be no credits deducted. Validation of the message will take place, and you will also receive a normal response back from the API.
optional_parameters.name: test

optional_parameters.description: If you want a dlr notification of the message send to another url then that you have set on the web site, you can use this parameter.
optional_parameters.name: dlr_url

required_parameters.description: Sender of the message. Can be numeric or alphanumeric.
required_parameters.name: sender

required_parameters.default: This is a gsm 7-bit test message.
required_parameters.description: The message that needs to be sent. If the body contains signs that are not listed in the GSM-7 table, it is considered UTF-8.
required_parameters.name: body

required_parameters.description: One or several receivers, separated by a comma.
required_parameters.name: destination
